svg.aria-label: Week by week, Weeks 2 to 7. Group 1: Opening Remarks in Week 2, Seminar in Week 3, video due in Week 4. Group 2: Opening Remarks in Week 3, Seminar in Week 4, video due in Week 5. Group 3: Opening Remarks in Week 4, Seminar in Week 5, video due in Week 6. Group 4: Opening Remarks in Week 5, Seminar in Week 6, video due in Week 7. In every other week with a presentation, your group is the audience.

g.text: Week 2 · Group 1 gives its Opening Remarks. Groups 2, 3 and 4 are the audience.
Week 3 · Group 1 gives its Seminar. Then Group 2 gives its Opening Remarks.
Week 4 · Group 2’s Seminar, then Group 3’s Opening Remarks. Group 1’s video is due.
Week 5 · Group 3’s Seminar, then Group 4’s Opening Remarks. Group 2’s video is due.
Week 6 · Group 4’s Seminar. Group 3’s video is due.
Week 7 · Group 4’s video is due. The Seminar + Portfolio task is finished.
